passage.text: Are you going to visit a temple in Thailand?
passage.reading: ər juː ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈvɪzɪt ə ˈtɛmpəl ɪn ˈtaɪlænd?

passage.text: Then please wear the right clothes.
passage.reading: ˈðɛn ˈpliːz ˈwɛr ðə ˈraɪt ˈkloʊðz.

passage.text: It's polite to cover your shoulders and your knees.
passage.reading: ɪts pəˈlaɪt tə ˈkʌvər jʊr ˈʃoʊldərz ənd jʊr ˈniːz.

passage.text: Don't wear shorts or short skirts.
passage.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈwɛr ˈʃɔːrts ɔːr ˈʃɔːrt ˈskɜːrts.

passage.text: If your shirt doesn't cover your shoulders, wear a scarf over them.
passage.reading: ɪf jʊr ˈʃɜːrt ˈdʌzənt ˈkʌvər jʊr ˈʃoʊldərz, ˈwɛr ə ˈskɑːrf ˈoʊvər ðɛm.

passage.text: You must take off your shoes before you go into the temple building.
passage.reading: juː mʌst ˈteɪk ˈɔːf jʊr ˈʃuːz bɪˈfɔːr juː ˈɡoʊ ˈɪntuː ðə ˈtɛmpəl ˌbɪldɪŋ.

passage.text: And please speak quietly in the temple.
passage.reading: ənd ˈpliːz ˈspiːk ˈkwaɪətli ɪn ðə ˈtɛmpəl.

passage.text: If you follow these rules, you'll have a great visit.
passage.reading: ɪf juː ˈfɑːloʊ ðiːz ˈruːlz, juːl ˈhæv ə ˈɡreɪt ˈvɪzɪt.
